questions.answer: You could write to the course cordinator for pharmaceutical science

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The courses were good and had a decent level, however they were 1/2 credits so you will have a lot of differnet courses

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was more conference oriented, so you had the courses for 2/3 full days and then an exam on the last day or an exam at a later point. It was more industry oriented compared to UCPH.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Medical devices and applied project management. Medical devices was really interesting and had a site visit. Applied project management is good if you want insights to how project management works in the pharma industry.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer:
Most cantons of switzerland are very nice, here are some places/cities:
Luzern, Bern, Lugano, Interlaken, St morritz, Bellinzona (hiking), Lichtenstein, Geneve, Montreux, Lausanne, Basel, Grindenwald/Lauterbrunnen, Arth goldau (hiking), Zermatt, Appenzell, Schaffhausen.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It was very easy and people are nice

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Be open and be outgoing.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Not any really, just the language is weird

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Not really culture, but the beautiful nature.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Be open, do daytrips/weekend trips and stay calm.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Get the half-fare travel card and the 25/7 travel card.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The nature and the friends i met here.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The beginning getting adjusted to everything

questions.answer: Yes
